# Names the store refuses, written below the own account: 400 for what is
# no name at all (.., an encoded "/", NUL, control characters), 403 for a
# name the rules refuse (leading dot, too long, wrong extension, a
# collection id outside [a-z0-9-] or a UUID). Nothing is written, nothing
# outside the collection is touched. Below another account it stays 404
# (nothing about other accounts); reading a bad name is 404.

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/..
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 400

> Content-Type: text/calendar
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 400
